method.cases: Insert one blank or image-only page after the first source page of all 100 native PDF fixtures. Alternate page types by stable case index.
method.controls: Exclude the inserted page and independently reject every mixed-page input. App regression checks malformed or missing native word boxes.
method.gate: Keep at least four useful generated locations across two groups, with no new false group and complete scope and original coordinates for all retained contexts.
method.second: Rerun the pinned second check on each exact ordered PDF request for both mixed and intact source scope. Collapse identical complete requests only.
method.window: Reuse prior positive first responses only after checking the whole extracted text, every ordered input hash and complete native boxes. Keep only first six positive inputs wholly within a single selectable-text page.
